title: Quarantine identifiable delegation rows with non-text payloads without certifying a partial scan
outcome: Assess and implement raw-value fingerprinting plus quarantine for a readable delegation ID whose value_json is non-TEXT or invalid UTF-8, while retaining fatal handling of step/iteration failures and preserving every durable row.
acceptance: Quarantine identifiable delegation rows with non-text payloads without certifying a partial scan is done
